decision: Extend the collection-items convention to organisms, approving its use for organism collections such as CalendarGridProps.items; the convention meaning, avoid list, aliases and exceptions are unchanged.

evidence.channel: Owner decision forwarded in odd/tasks/organisms-build.md L28, 2026-11-02
evidence.interpretation: Explicit convention approval reported by the parent; this is not a signed or independent receipt.

before.whenToUse: A molecule renders its own standard entry, with its sub-parts, for each element of a consumer-supplied list.

after.whenToUse: An organism or molecule renders its own standard entry, with its sub-parts, for each element of a consumer-supplied list.

semanticAmendments.boundary: Convention applicability only; no new convention, name, exception, component, token, dependency or automatic API migration.

convention.name: items
convention.meaning: Ordered data describing the entries a composite component renders, such as tabs, menu entries or navigation links; the entry shape is component-specific.
convention.whenToUse: An organism or molecule renders its own standard entry, with its sub-parts, for each element of a consumer-supplied list.
convention.avoid: Selectable form options (use choice-options/options), free composition through children, or ReactNode lists without a defined entry shape.
